## Production release

Promotes the complete current `develop` branch at `3c6d4c38e8564b0cf778806ccb089559a63ecbc7` to `main`, as explicitly requested.

Voice/shared-runtime changes called out for this release:

- #20167: emit audio for complete single-sentence replies instead of waiting forever for a nonexistent remainder
- #20411: retry OpenRouter`s exact transient `400 No models provided` routing rejection once in the shared Workerd fallback used by streamed phone voice and text
- existing inbound target resolution, signed Twilio streaming, Cartesia configuration, first-call prewarm, fixed first/returning greetings, confirmed-word barge-in, and shared conversation continuity already on `develop`
- all other changes currently landed on `develop`

## Verification

- 12/12 focused shared-provider fallback tests pass at the fix head
- 9/9 text-splitting tests pass with the short-reply fix
- 23/23 focused Twilio target, signing, TwiML, codec, bootstrap, continuity, and prewarm tests pass in isolation
- `packages/cloud/shared` typecheck passes
- exact plugin-openai sibling provider patch was independently exercised: 34/34 focused Vitest assertions pass, but its author draft #20335 remains unmerged because it does not cover the shared Workerd phone path
- production deployment and real phone/text proof will be verified against the resulting `main` SHA before declaring the release complete

## Audit disposition

- #20380 (Nubs Personal Shared Telegram edge): remains draft, staging-gated, and unrelated to phone voice; not forced into production
- #20275 (shared follow-up repair bundle): remains a broad 100+ file draft without exact-head release evidence; not forced into production
- #19835 (async sandbox-backed deletes): remains draft and unrelated to the call regression

This is a full `develop` promotion (453 commits / 1,077 changed files versus current `main`), not a direct hotfix to `main`. The repository-wide local gate was limited by missing native `node-swiftlint` in the scoped install and local disk exhaustion during core package tarball verification; hosted release checks and post-deploy probes remain authoritative.

topPRs.title: fix(shared): integrate audited agent follow-up repairs
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Closes #20274. This is the integration branch for the audited Nubs Shared-agent stack. It supersedes corrected source work from the earlier reminder, grounding, projection, capability-wall, gateway-auth, runtime-routing, iOS, and Telegram-edge drafts; corrected #20462 and #20488 are replayed here, while #20468 is now upstream on `develop`.

## Integrated outcomes

- durable Shared reminder claims, retry/recovery, stable receipt identity, content bounds, and connector contracts
- bounded public-web grounding projected as untrusted tool evidence through REST/SSE, history merge, formal cutover, and lazy Dedicated repair
- sender projection as a candidate-user hint only, with one canonical sender/user/current-org/current-Dedicated snapshot revalidation on every hit
- raw authenticated connector utterances separated from speaker wrappers; repeated blocked secondary capabilities remain visible and typed
- pre-evaluator context authorization and typed non-persisted missing-capability outcomes
- saturated retrieval ties no longer promote an arbitrary registration-order winner; a genuine sole maximum remains available
- one canonical Telegram delivery authority for Worker and official Railway traffic, stable bot/sender scopes, fenced renewable claims, typed acceptance, multipart progress/receipts, and ambiguity tombstones
- authenticated lazy Worker request scope for the real Telegram turn/LINK paths; edge rollout stays false until protected activation proof exists
- short-lived Discord/webhook gateway request tokens with fail-closed ordinary-token revocation, paced renewal, strict response parsing, and lifecycle fencing
- explicit runtime selection owns both HTTP and realtime credential authority
- iOS-local chooser rebuild safety and focus-scoped, serialized keyboard-accessory ownership
- corrected ambient-chat native glass without removing Home `[CHOICE]` controls or hiding serving-provider attribution
- authoritative backup and agent-list UI state, including truthful provisioned/stopped labels
- browser-safe app-loading contracts and the bounded CI/test-harness repairs found while integrating

The stack deliberately reverts merged #20364: its local-only settings encryption leaks plaintext through active PGlite/Electric write-back and accepts ciphertext-shaped plaintext. A replacement needs one versioned authenticated storage codec, immutable committed snapshots, and a migration/rotation contract.
